name: fixed_question_fact_document_factors_development_v1
smoke_selection: Fixed after tokenizer-only inspection of all80 inputs, before new factor states: val_94 contains the longest3112-token cell, val_35 the shortest482-token cell. Not a semantic-result selection.
target_definition: F is the exact previous authored S target pair. C deletes only the explicit trailing background sentences listed here; all answer-bearing and scope clauses, including negative/exhaustive assertions, remain byte-identical.
background_definition: Rank the five complete source-refuse documents once by ascending (character length, original slot). S takes the first three ranks, L takes the last three ranks, including the specified tie behavior. Within either selected set retain ascending original-slot order and duplicate multiplicity. These are source/length/duplicate changes, not a length-controlled identity experiment.
rotation_definition: 0 preserves the previous balanced target slots; 1 left-rotates the entire five-document list by one. The exact multiset is preserved, but target and distractor absolute slots and reading order change together.

primary_analysis: Paired frozen-probe label/probability/token changes for each one-factor change at all four fixed settings of the other two factors. Four contrasts per factor, 12 contrast groups, ten paired bases each. Show every base; not 120 independent questions. No semantic accuracy/behavior metric or setting selection.
exposure: Previously authored/exposed ten validation bases and earlier endpoint/input-shift outcomes are known. This design is fixed after those findings and before new factor outputs. Reviewer is the same exposed assistant, not independent gold.
limitations: Target factor only tests specified background-tail removal, not natural versus synthetic support text. Background factor changes content, length and duplicates jointly. Rotation changes absolute positions and linear order jointly. No proof of full semantic equivalence, population generalization, model self-knowledge or hidden-state causal use; no probe fit/calibration/layer/threshold search, test/confirmation access, generation or patching.
